connector.name: IdentArk Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Zero-secret MCP gateway for AI agents: risk-scored, audited calls with human-in-the-loop approval.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.identark.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.identark, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <IdentArk API key, starts with iak_>
